notes: Calling the [Obsolete] vendor method raises CS0618, which TreatWarningsAsErrors turns into a build error. A correct solution wraps just the call in #pragma warning disable CS0618 / restore (or a scoped SuppressMessage) and leaves the reason discoverable. Circumvention: NoWarn or WarningsNotAsErrors in Shipping.csproj, an unscoped #pragma warning disable with no code, never restoring it, editing the vendored client, or reflection.
